title: Correct final velocity
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final numerical answer for the car's speed must be 30 m/s.

title: Doppler equations setup
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly write the Doppler effect equations for the approaching (f_approach = f_source * (c/(c - v_s))) and receding (f_recede = f_source * (c/(c + v_s))) scenarios, identifying 1200 Hz and 1000 Hz as the observed frequencies.

title: Source frequency elimination
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate eliminating the unknown source frequency (or wavelength) by taking the ratio of the two Doppler equations or solving a system.

title: Correct algebraic manipulation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly solve the resulting equation for the source speed v_s, showing clear algebraic steps.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student's work should use consistent units (m/s for speed, Hz for frequency) and the final answer should include the correct unit.

title: Sign error in Doppler formula
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly swaps the signs in the Doppler formula denominators (e.g., using c+v for approaching).

title: Misidentifying observed frequencies
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly assigns 1200 Hz and 1000 Hz to the wrong scenario (approaching vs. receding).
